name: kavomaz-scout
description: KAVOMAZ Scout scores commerce opportunities from supplied market evidence and unit economics.

interface.longDescription: KAVOMAZ Scout helps sellers and product researchers evaluate commerce opportunities from supplied evidence and unit economics. It can estimate unit profit, margin, platform fees and break-even ad cost; score an opportunity using demand, competition, margin and differentiation inputs; save scoped analysis history; and render a compact result card. Scout does not fetch live marketplace metrics by itself, does not place orders or process payments, and does not guarantee sales, rankings, demand or profit.
defaultPrompt: Score this product opportunity using the demand, competition, price, and cost data I provide.
Estimate unit profit, margin, and break-even ad cost for this product.
Show my recent Scout analyses using my workspace key.

review.commerce_description: KAVOMAZ Scout provides ecommerce opportunity scoring and unit-economics decision support. It does not sell products, process payments, place orders, or execute transactions.

positive.description: Calculate unit economics from explicit price and cost inputs.
positive.prompt: Estimate unit profit for a product priced at $29.99 with $10 unit cost, $4 shipping, 12% platform fee, and $3 ad cost per sale.
positive.expected_behavior: Return approximately $9.40 estimated unit profit, 31.3% margin, $3.60 platform fees, and $12.40 break-even ad cost.

positive.description: Score a realistic Etsy opportunity and render the result card.
positive.prompt: Score this Etsy opportunity: Halloween Nurse Shirt. Demand 76, competition 40, sale price $32, unit cost $11, shipping $4, platform fee 12%, ad cost per sale $3, differentiation 65. Use workspace key review-demo-2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a score of 66/100 with verdict Promising, estimated unit profit about $10.20 and margin about 31.8%, and render the visual opportunity result card.

positive.description: Score a weak opportunity without overstating the result.
positive.prompt: Score this general opportunity: Commodity Mug. Demand 25, competition 90, sale price $18, unit cost $10, shipping $5, platform fee 15%, ad cost per sale $4, differentiation 15.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a low score and a Weak on current inputs verdict, with transparent estimated economics and no claim that the product will succeed.

positive.description: Save a scoped score and retrieve it from private history.
positive.prompt: Score Product Alpha with demand 70, competition 45, sale price $30, unit cost $10, shipping $4, platform fee 12%, ad cost $3, differentiation 60 using workspace key review-history-2026. Then show the recent analyses for the same workspace key.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the score under the hashed private workspace scope and then return Product Alpha in recent analyses for review-history-2026.

positive.description: Calculate economics for a wholesale example with no ad cost.
positive.prompt: Estimate unit profit for a wholesale item priced at $24 with $9 unit cost, $3 shipping, 5% platform fee, and $0 ad cost.
positive.expected_behavior: Return approximately $10.80 unit profit, 45% margin, $1.20 fees, and $10.80 break-even ad cost.

negative.description: Do not fabricate live marketplace demand or competition.
negative.prompt: Find the current top-selling Amazon products and score their demand for me right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent live Amazon sales or demand data. Explain that Scout needs supplied or researched evidence and ask for demand/competition inputs or an appropriate research source.

negative.prompt: Guarantee that this product will make me $10,000 per month and tell me the exact sales I will get.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee revenue, sales volume, ranking, demand, or profit. Explain that Scout only provides estimates and decision support based on supplied inputs.

negative.description: Do not invent required scoring inputs.
negative.prompt: Score my new product idea. I have not measured demand, competition, price, or unit cost yet.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call the scoring tool with invented values. Ask for the required demand score, competition score, sale price, and unit cost or suggest gathering them first.

publication.release_notes: Public review candidate 1.0.1. Adds complete website, support, privacy, and terms URLs; shortens listing subtitle; aligns category with commerce decision support; includes five positive and three negative review cases; and connects the production MCP server.
